products.short_description: Export a complete inventory of Copilot Agent Builder agents and who each is shared with (users & groups) from Microsoft Graph — with the exact answer on the /copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} endpoint: what it returns, why your request is blocked (401/403/404), and the supported fix. Filtered to Agent Builder, Copilot Studio excluded. Guide + 5 scripts.
products.description:
You tried to pull your Copilot agents from Graph — and the request was blocked

People across your organization are building Copilot Agent Builder agents and sharing them with colleagues and groups. Governance needs two things: a complete inventory of those agents, and for each one, who it is shared with. You called GET /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} and it failed — and now you can't tell whether the endpoint is wrong, your permissions are wrong, the feature isn't switched on, or the data simply isn't exposed. This package answers that exactly, and gives you a supported, repeatable export.

The direct answer on that endpoint

  • Your endpoint is the right one. /copilot/admin/catalog/packages (list) and /{id} (per-agent detail) are the documented Copilot Package Management API — the correct namespace, now available in both v1.0 and beta.
  • The sharing data you wanted IS there. The per-agent detail returns allowedUsersAndGroups — the exact users and groups an agent is shared with. (The list call only returns an all/some/none summary; you must call the per-id detail to get the recipients — a detail most people miss.)
  • Why it was blocked is one of four concrete causes — a missing CopilotPackages.Read.All scope or consent, an insufficient admin role, the Microsoft Agent 365 entitlement the current docs require, or the API not yet rolled out to your tenant — and the package's decision tree tells them apart from the raw 401/403/404.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin follows end to end — backed by five ready-to-run PowerShell scripts.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; a preflight that signs in and decodes precisely why (or that) Graph works for you; every object you create is named and reused verbatim.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open consulting meter that runs into the thousands per day; the export is read-only and reusable on every run.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with a hard reconciliation gate: the export must match the admin center before you trust the register.

Two supported paths to the same register

  • Path A — Microsoft 365 admin center (no code, no extra entitlement): filter the Agent Registry to Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder and Export to CSV. Works today for any admin — your route if Agent 365 is ruled out.
  • Path B — Microsoft Graph Package Management API (scriptable, schedulable, includes the granular allowedUsersAndGroups sharing detail resolved to names).

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what Agent Builder agents are, where they surface for admins, the honest beta-endpoint reality, and the two-path approach.
  • Requirements Guide — 9 requirements, each with Description / Why / Verify / Implement-if-missing: admin roles, the exact Graph scope, the Agent 365 entitlement reality, tenant rollout, and the Commercial-vs-Government endpoint table.
  • Implementation Guide — connect, preflight & decode the failure, list agents filtered to Agent Builder (Copilot Studio excluded), resolve sharing to users/groups, build the register, pilot, expand, schedule.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — preflight/failure-decoder, inventory export, sharing export (allowedUsersAndGroups → names), Agent-Builder-only filter, and the governance-register generator. All read-only, all with -Environment Global|USGov|USGovDoD.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides — 10 pass/fail gates, plus the full blocked/failed-request decision tree (permission vs role vs Agent 365 vs feature-not-enabled vs undocumented vs real limitation).

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the export and the review cadence every month and across projects.

The bottom line

A trustworthy, repeatable register of every Agent Builder agent and exactly who it is shared with — scoped cleanly to Agent Builder, with the Graph endpoint mystery solved and a no-Agent-365 fallback so you can produce the inventory today.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited runs — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF & Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting decision tree, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 read-only scripts, all with -Environment Global|USGov|USGovDoD:
    • AGBINV-Connect-Preflight.ps1 — verifies scopes/roles and decodes the 401/403/404 into a named cause
    • AGBINV-Export-AgentInventory.ps1 — lists agents filtered to Agent Builder (excludes Copilot Studio) → inventory CSV
    • AGBINV-Export-AgentSharing.ps1 — per-agent allowedUsersAndGroups resolved to user/group names → sharing CSV
    • AGBINV-Filter-AgentBuilderOnly.ps1 — reduces any export to Agent Builder only
    • AGBINV-Report-GovernanceRegister.ps1 — merges inventory + sharing into the review register

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
